- Companies: Chengdu Aircraft Corporation

Facts:
- The Saturn AL-31 is a family of military turbofan engines.
- The Saturn AL-31 currently powers all Sukhoi Su-27 derivatives and the Chengdu J-10 multirole jet fighter developed by China.
- The Chengdu J-10, NATO reporting name Firebird, is a lightweight multirole fighter aircraft capable of all-weather operation.
- The Chengdu J-10 uses a delta wing and canard configuration with fly-by-wire flight controls.
- Chengdu Aircraft Corporation in China produces the Chengdu J-10 for the People's Liberation Army Air Force.
- All members of the Sukhoi S-54 family resemble the Sukhoi Su-27 or more closely the Sukhoi Su-33, but they are smaller and built around a single Saturn AL-31 engine instead of two.
